claims: Leonardo da Vinci was an Italian High Renaissance polymath, painter, scientist, and inventor.
Leonardo da Vinci was born on April 15, 1452.
Leonardo da Vinci died on May 2, 1519.
Leonardo da Vinci's major works include Mona Lisa, The Last Supper, Vitruvian Man, Lady with an Ermine, and anatomical, botanical, and engineering sketches.
Leonardo da Vinci conceptualized flying machines.
Leonardo da Vinci conceptualized armored vehicles (tanks).
Leonardo da Vinci conceptualized concentrated solar power.
Leonardo da Vinci conceptualized early hydraulic machinery.
Leonardo da Vinci often recorded his inventions and designs in his notebooks.
Leonardo.Ai is a generative AI suite for creating images and game assets.
Leonardo (S.p.A.) is an Italian aerospace, defense, and security company.
Leonardo/ISAST is a not-for-profit organization focusing on the intersection of arts, science, and technology.
Leonardo DiCaprio is an American actor and film producer.
